scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Create a bot through BotFather; bot token is sufficient for the Bot API.
app.surface: HTTP Bot API; messages, files and chat management
app.note: Bot capabilities differ from Telegram user-account APIs; label this as the Bot API toolkit.
app.next_action: Create a Telegram test bot and retrieve an update generated by a test chat, with explicit Bot API scope.
app.success_criterion: Return the test chat/update identifiers and prevent unrelated update data from being logged.
app.alternative_action: Keep user-account automation outside this toolkit; the Bot API and user-account APIs have different capabilities.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
